title: Kakeya Conjecture Lab: an interactive lab with a box-counting dimension meter
description: An interactive exploration of the Kakeya conjecture. Its dimension meter performs genuine box counting on sets whose dimension is known, so the reader can see the estimator's own bias — large enough to show why no finite computation settles the conjecture.

creators.name: Cheng, Guo
